sample_unit: cases (100 complex cases plus 20 adversarial cases)

links.outcome: Model behavior on adversarial, biologically implausible 'mix-up' pathology cases
links.effect: Models frequently failed to detect biological contradictions and confidently diagnosed nonsensical mix-up cases instead of refusing them; no numeric rate given in abstract.
links.quote: Models frequently failed to detect biological contradictions, confidently diagnosing nonsensical “mix-up” cases rather than refusing them.

links.outcome: Whether LLMs refuse or defer impossible clinical scenarios rather than diagnosing
links.effect: Models confidently diagnosed impossible cases rather than refusing; best model GPT-5 reached 70% accuracy on full evidence, but safety performance was described as alarming.
links.quote: This reveals a critical safety gap: high diagnostic capability is currently coupled with a dangerous inability to recognize impossible clinical scenarios.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs on a diagnostic pathology benchmark (including adversarial safety stress-testing cases) without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
